title: Can I MASTER 4 Player Chess?
summary: Player plays five chess.com 4 Player Chess games against humans on the 14x14 cross board, with a placement table (1st place etc.) and 5-game counter.
rules: Four armies: red (bottom, player), blue (left), yellow (top), green (right); turn order red, blue, yellow, green (clockwise).
Pieces move as in standard chess; pawns move toward the opposite side and promote (chess.com FFA: promote on the 8th rank, i.e. the centre line) — inferred from chess.com FFA rules.
FFA points: capturing pieces scores points; checkmating a player eliminates them (+20); highest points / last standing wins. Placement 1st-4th shown.
win_condition: Finish 1st in the placement table (most points/last standing).

opponent.name: 3 online human opponents (chess.com 4PC)
opponent.avatar_description: chess.com usernames at each side of the cross board

pieces.notes: four colours: red, blue, yellow, green

setup: Each army on its edge: back row R N B Q K B N R (red/yellow), K/Q swapped for blue/green per chess.com 4PC; pawns in front. Files d-k (8 middle columns/rows).
events: Placement table at end of each game
evidence: Frames (research/frames/visual_*.jsonl): {"start_pieces": "4 standard armies (yellow top, green right, red bottom, blue left)", "special": "5-game counter, placement table (1st: 2 wins...)", "opponent_ui": "chess.com 4PC humans"}. No rules.jsonl line.  Rules are the standard published rules of this variant (frames show the chess.com variant; transcript unavailable), so rule details are from the variant's known definition.

vfx_timeline.effect: piece slides to target; from/to squares highlighted
captured piece removed as mover lands
modal 'You Won!'/'You Lost!'/'Draw!' with Play Again
